From: Aisha Ahmed <aisha.ahmed@clearedhealth.com>

Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Evidence request — admin activity, retention & export options

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this through. As part of ClearedHealth's procurement review we need a concise artifact that describes:

- What administrative actions are recorded (user administration, role changes, API key ops, model pinning, token refunds, config rollbacks)
- Retention windows per event class (auth, admin, operator, system) and deletion policy for PII
- Supported export formats and delivery channels (SFTP, AWS S3 signed, signed ZIP with manifest, streaming API)
- Redaction and sampling options for evidence bundles (timebox, user filter)
- Proof of custody (checksums, signed manifests)

Can you provide a small deliverable (PDF or CSV + short playbook) and confirm timeline? We need this for our SOC 2 evidence pack and procurement checklist.

Best,
Aisha Ahmed
Senior Security Engineer
ClearedHealth

---
Attachment: evidence_requirements_clearedhealth.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Ahmed <aisha.ahmed@clearedhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence request — admin activity, retention & export options

Aisha — thanks for outlining this. We can produce a concise deliverable. Quick answers up front:

- Logged admin actions (examples): role/grant changes, user provisioning/deprovisioning, API key create/revoke, model pin/version changes, canary/rollout events, manual token adjustments, RBAC exceptions.
- Retention: default admin activity ledger retained 365 days; operator traces 90 days; configurable extensions available for Dedicated/Private customers (up to 7 years via contract).
- Exports: signed ZIP (SHA256 manifest), SFTP push, AWS S3 signed presigned URLs, or scoped streaming export (HTTP with token).
- Redaction: field-level redaction via export filters + sampling by user/timebox. We also provide a scrubbed preview for PII-sensitive exports.

I'll attach a short matrix and a playbook draft. Kim, Marissa — looped to confirm the retention numbers and any SOC-2 specific attestation language we should include.

Next step: I'll package a 2-page PDF and a CSV matrix. Is EOD Thursday (26th) acceptable?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_admin_activity_matrix.csv (CSV stub), export_playbook_v1.pdf (PDF stub)

From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence request — admin activity, retention & export options

Jonas — confirming retention and a couple clarifications for the playbook:

- Retention details to include in customer-facing artifact:
  * Admin ledger (role, grant, key ops): 365 days default; can be extended to 3 years for Dedicated with purchase; Private deploys customer-managed.
  * Operator runtime traces / ephemeral KV cache logs: 90 days; we maintain aggregated metrics indefinitely (no raw cache).
  * Audit exports (snapshots): retained per customer S3 lifecycle -- we recommend 90 days unless requested otherwise.

- Export formats: emphasize SHA256 manifest + manifest signing with HMAC (internal key) and optional PGP for customer's preferred key.
- Redaction: we should offer an automated PII-scan stage before packaging; flag for legal review if customer requests full raw.

I'll add a short SOC-2 attestation paragraph: "Redwood captures administrative actions described above and provides tamper-evident export bundles upon request; our platform supports configurable retention policies for Dedicated/Private deployments."

Marissa — can you add the delivery SLAs (SFTP push within 48 hours, on-demand presigned S3 within 24 hours, courier/attested bundles negotiable)?

Kim
